name: Mima Menu Builder
author: Mohammad Ansari

sections.description:
Mima Menu Builder helps you build and manage a clean, mobile-friendly digital menu for businesses that display food, drinks, desserts, or menu-based products.

It is designed for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, dessert shops, juice bars, food trucks, cloud kitchens, hotels, and hospitality businesses that need a simple and beautiful way to present their menu online.

From one WordPress dashboard, you can manage your business profile, multiple menus, categories, menu items, add-ons, languages, currencies, themes, and reception display.

You can create separate menus for dine-in, delivery, catering, events, breakfast, and more. Each menu can have its own selected items, active/inactive status, shortcode, and theme.

Use the shortcode [mimamenu] to display the default menu on any page, or use a menu-specific shortcode such as [mimamenu id=”1″] to display a specific menu.

Free Features

  • Business profile management
  • Multiple menus for dine-in, delivery, catering, events, breakfast, and more
  • Menu-specific item selection, status, shortcode, and theme selection
  • Menu categories with images, sorting, visibility controls, filters, and bulk actions
  • Menu items with images, prices, descriptions, filters, bulk actions, and duplicate tools
  • Add-ons management for extra menu choices
  • Multiple languages managed from Business Profile
  • Multiple currencies and item pricing
  • Theme gallery with live preview
  • Reception Display with live tablet preview
  • Import and export tools for menu data
  • Separate import and export tools for add-ons
  • Mobile-friendly front-end menu
  • Default shortcode: [mimamenu]
  • Menu-specific shortcode: [mimamenu id=”1″]
  • Powered by Mima Menu branding

Built For

  • Cafes
  • Restaurants
  • Bakeries
  • Dessert shops
  • Ice cream shops
  • Juice bars
  • Food trucks
  • Cloud kitchens
  • Hotel and hospitality menus
  • Any food or drink menu-based business

Shortcodes

Use this shortcode to display your default active menu on any page or post:

[mimamenu]

Use a menu-specific shortcode to display a selected menu:

[mimamenu id=”1″]

You can copy each menu shortcode from Mima Menu > Menus.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mima-menu-builder/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Mima Menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Add your business profile, menus, categories, items, add-ons, languages, currencies, and theme.
  5. Add the shortcode [mimamenu] to any page.
sections.faq:
Is Mima Menu Builder only for restaurants?

No. It can be used for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, dessert shops, juice bars, food trucks, cloud kitchens, hotels, hospitality menus, and other food or drink menu-based businesses.

Can I display the menu on any page?

Yes. Add the shortcode [mimamenu] to any page or post.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes. You can add and manage multiple menu languages from the Business Profile section.

Does it support multiple currencies?

Yes. You can manage currencies and item prices from the dashboard.

Can I import and export my menu?

Yes. Mima Menu Builder includes import and export tools to help you manage menu data faster.

Does it include add-ons?

Yes. You can create add-on groups and add-on items to display extra menu choices.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes. Mima Menu Builder is designed for mobile-friendly digital menus.

Can I create more than one menu?

Yes. You can create separate menus for dine-in, delivery, catering, events, breakfast, and more from the Menus page.

Can each menu have its own theme?

Yes. Each menu can use its own theme setting.

Can I show a specific menu on a page?

Yes. Copy the menu shortcode from Mima Menu > Menus, for example [mimamenu id=”1″].

Does the free version include online ordering?

No. This free version focuses on creating and displaying a digital menu.
